fields.name: openOnSlash
fields.description: Whether typing `/` after whitespace opens the menu (default: true).

fields.name: sections
fields.description: Application sections appended to the menu, or merged into a built-in section with the same ID.

fields.name: defaultItems
fields.description: Whether to include SuperDoc's built-in items (default: true).

fields.name: menuProvider
fields.type: (context: ContextMenuOpenContext, sections: readonly ContextMenuResolvedSection[]) => readonly ContextMenuResolvedSection[] | null | undefined
fields.description: Filter or reorder the resolved sections before they render. Return `null` or `undefined` to keep the original list.
